item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Sviluppo e studio meccanicistico di metodologie catalitiche stereoselettive per trasformazioni radicaliche (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-04 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-05 Chimica organica

The research will focus on developing new stereoselective methodologies for radical transformations, combining synthetic organic chemistry, transition-metal catalysis and visible-light photochemistry. Activities will include the design and optimization of catalytic reactions, investigation of substrate scope, synthesis and characterization of organic compounds, and mechanistic studies aimed at understanding radical reactivity and stereocontrol. The resulting catalytic concepts will contribute to the development of innovative catalytic systems within the ERC PHOTOZYME project, including their potential application to light-driven enzymatic transformations.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: 2026-IdrDip-17-chimica - Photoinduced approaches for the valorization of bioplastics under metal-free conditions (Univ. PAVIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-23 12:00
Institution: Univ. PAVIA, Pavia
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-05 Chimica organica

The research program involves: 1) the study of photoinduced processes for the valorization of bioplastics under metal-free conditions; 2) the development of photoorganocatalyzed processes for the modification of the backbone of bioplastic materials; 3) the implementation of processes for the controlled depolymerization of bioplastic materials mediated by bio-based catalysts.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Development, optimization and application of conventional and green analytical methods based on liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry ("Campus Bio-Medico")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 12:00
Institution: "Campus Bio-Medico", Rome
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-01 Chimica analitica, ambientale e dei beni culturali

The overall objective of the project is to develop, optimize and validate innovative analytical methods combining conventional and green sample preparation techniques with high-performance liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry analysis. These methods will be applied for the determination of different classes of molecules in biological samples of clinical and nutritional interest, as well as in food matrices, including endogenous bioactive compounds present in foods and agri-food industry by-products, and exogenous molecules.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Re s o l v i n g t h e c omp l e x i t y o f nanoparticle-cell interactions in real-time and at nanoscale (ROMA "Tor Vergata")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-31 23:59
Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma, Rm
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-02 Chimica fisica

The goal of this research project i s t o dissect the mechanisms o f intracellular trafficking o f nanoparticles and the interactions/reactions of nanoparticles with cellular components to ultimately program and manipulate the nanoparticle induced cellular responses. The specific aims of this project are the engineering of set of biodegradable phytoglycogen nanoparticles with tunable size, surface charge and functionalities and the study o f intracellular biological activities o f nanoparticles b y nanoscopy and spectroscopy methodologies.

item.description:

Institution: Univ. PARMA, Parma
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-07 Chimica farmaceutica, tossicologica, nutraceutico-alimentare, delle fermentazioni e dei prodotti per il benessere e per la salute

The programme aims to develop and apply advanced metabolomics and bioinformatics methodologies for monitoring the safety and quality of the national durum wheat supply chain. By integrating high-resolution mass spectrometry, targeted and untargeted metabolomics, multivariate data analysis, and artificial intelligence, the project will identify biomarkers for the characterization of raw materials, the monitoring of processing steps, and the detection of contaminants. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Novel Photocatalytic Strategies for Organoboron Chemistry - 2026_IDR_DCMC_22 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-06 Fondamenti chimici delle tecnologie

The project aims to develop innovative photocatalytic strategies for the sustainable synthesis of organoboron compounds (OBCs), fundamental in organic chemistry and crucial for the pharmaceutical and materials sectors. Since traditional methods based on carbanion chemistry are poorly sustainable, an efficient and eco-compatible approach driven by visible light is proposed. Photocatalysis grants access to open-shell intermediates under mild conditions, a reactivity suited to boron substrates, whose vacant p orbital favours radical stabilisation.
